title: Swimming pool + rooftop club pool
body: A landscaped pool between the towers, and a second pool on the clubhouse roof.

title: Equipped gym
body: Cardio, free weights and a yoga deck overlooking the central green.

title: Clubhouse
body: Party hall, indoor games and a reading room that doubles as a quiet study. Rooftop pool upstairs.

title: Jogging track & lake edge
body: A looping jogging track through the gardens, running along the lake on the east side.

title: Children's play area
body: Fenced play area next to the pool, in sight of the walkway.

title: 24×7 gated security
body: Manned gates, visitor management and CCTV across common areas.

title: Full power back-up
body: DG back-up for common areas and limited back-up inside every flat.

title: Metro & borewell water
body: Treated water with an on-site STP; tanker supply has not been needed in summer.

title: Sports courts
body: Badminton, half basketball and a cricket practice net.

title: In-estate convenience store
body: Groceries, milk and pharmacy pick-up without leaving the gate.
